tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground and the default panel fill. Newsprint white; never tint it.

tokens.name: mayo
tokens.usage: Feature panels (the bucket panel, the hero panel), speech-bubble fill while editing, parked nuggets.

tokens.name: toast
tokens.usage: Halftone shading and floor shadows under illustrations only. Never text, never a panel fill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Every outline, every solid offset shadow and all primary text. Text on paper (18:1), mayo, nugget (10.4:1), raw and tomato (4.7:1).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, dates, placeholder text. Reads on paper (7.6:1) and mayo (6.9:1). Never on nugget or tomato.

tokens.name: nugget
tokens.usage: The one fill colour: nuggets, the masthead/toolbar strip, status pills for exploring and building. Text on it is always ink.

tokens.name: nugget-deep
tokens.usage: Crumb ticks inside a nugget outline. Decorative only; never text (1.5:1 on nugget).

tokens.name: raw
tokens.usage: Fill for a raw (undercooked) nugget and its status pill. Ink text on it (14.9:1).

tokens.name: burnt
tokens.usage: Fill for a killed (burnt) nugget and its status pill. Text on it is on-burnt (7.1:1).

tokens.name: tomato
tokens.usage: Bucket stripes, the action panel, the primary pill, sound-effect lettering at 40px+. As a line it is red ink: a danger pill's outline, an error caption's border, the PICK ME stamp (3.9:1 on paper, enough for a line). Text on it is on-tomato. As text on paper only at 24px+.

tokens.name: curry
tokens.usage: The sauce on a named nugget: the corner dab, the flood that reveals its project name, and the picked name sticker. Text on it is on-curry (4.8:1). Never a panel fill, never text.

tokens.name: curry-gloss
tokens.usage: Gloss streaks on curry and drips. Decorative only.

tokens.name: pickle
tokens.usage: Fill for a done nugget and its status pill. Ink text on it (10.4:1).

tokens.name: on-tomato
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tomato fill (4.7:1). White on tomato fails at body sizes, so it is ink.

tokens.name: on-burnt
tokens.usage: Text on a burnt fill (7.1:1).

tokens.name: on-curry
tokens.usage: Text on curry: the revealed project name and a picked name sticker (4.8:1, so 15px+ and bold, or 18px+). Ink on curry fails (3.9:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid outline, 3px offset, so it reads as a second inked line. At least 4.7:1 on every ground in the system, tomato included.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page at most: the bucket page's headline. Scale down with clamp() to 64px on narrow screens.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page headings inside a panel (the tray liner), and a nugget's title on its own page.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: A receipt scanner that argues back
styles.usage: Nugget titles on cards (25px there), dialog headings.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark, always lowercase with its full stop. In the strip only.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Pill labels. 20px on the large pill.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro copy under a display heading, and the first paragraph of a nugget's notes.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: OCR is the boring part. Try on-device text recognition first.
styles.usage: Everything else that is read: notes, form help, empty states.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Values in a fact list (links, tags) and inline emphasis.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase captions, panel eyebrows, statuses, dates. Always uppercase.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Tags, always lowercase with a leading #. Chips and card footers.

styles.name: sfx-xl
styles.usage: The one-off moment lettering (TIP!, PLOP!) that pops over the page during an event, then leaves.

styles.name: sfx
styles.usage: Resting sound effects inside a panel (CRUNCH! on a nugget's hero, NUGGETS on the bucket label).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a chip row and between tags.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: The white gutter between panels. Always this, never more: it is what makes the page read as a comic strip.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between pills in a group.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page padding around the panel grid (16px under 700px).

tokens.name: panel-pad
tokens.usage: Padding inside a reading panel.

tokens.name: card-gap
tokens.usage: Column gap between nugget cards on the tray (34px between rows).

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels and strips. Just enough to soften the ink corner.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Text inputs and textareas inside dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Thought bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-sticker
tokens.usage: Name stickers: square enough to read as a cut-out label.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, chip, status pill and the search field.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The ink line on panels, pills, strips and the search field.

tokens.name: line-thin
tokens.usage: Chips, status pills, form fields: the smaller the thing, the thinner its line.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered pill: it moves up-left 2px and leaves this ink block behind.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Dialogs, which sit on the page like a sticker. The only rectangular shadow at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-stamp
tokens.usage: Name stickers at rest, so they read as stuck on rather than pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-thought
tokens.usage: A thought bubble floating over the page.
